theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → Measurable f → Measurable G → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in M, ‖G x‖ₑ * g x ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), NullMeasurableSet {x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ G x ≠ 0} (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ ({x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ G x ≠ 0} ∩ K) (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (ξ x).comp ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖G x‖⁻¹ • G x))))) ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict {x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ G x ≠ 0})
